dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibiting high-frequency, jagged perimeter edges with a sharp transition from dark-tone exterior to light-grey/white interior. Geometry is predominantly semi-circular to polygonal with rounded vertices.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of low-intensity (near-black) solid pixel islands concentrated in the interstitial spaces between the light annuli; core pixel concentration of light-colored patches is highest in the mid-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral with obtuse internal angles at the dorsal-most points.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct visualization of five separate, dark, curved keratinized structures (claws) on the distal margin of the pectoral flipper.
